phase3.rideHelp: Rịọ ụgbọ. Anaghị egosi nọmba ekwentị. Zute n'ebe ọha.
phase3.partnersHelp: Obere otu atọ atọ na-elekọta ibe ha.
phase3.caption: Nkọwa foto
phase3.qaHelp: Jụọ na-amaghị aha. Ndị otu nọ n'ihu na-aza.
phase3.merchHelp: Akara koodu naanị. Ọ dịghị ihe dị n'èzí na-akọwa ihe ha pụtara, enweghị ụbọchị e biri.
phase3.shareHelp: Otu kaadị nwere ọnụọgụ ọganihu gị.
phase3.archiveHelp: Kachie ozi maka onwe gị. Ọ na-emeghe n'ụbọchị dị ịrịba ama.
phase3.matchHelp: Onye nnọchite gị na-agwa ndị nnọchite ndị ọzọ okwu na mbụ. Agbanyụrụ mkpakọrịta nwoke na nwaanyị ugbu a. Ị nwere ike ịhụ ihe kpatara ya, rịọ mmeghe na nwale ọzọ.
phase3.datingOff: Agbanyụrụ mkpakọrịta ruo mgbe iwu ụbọchị kacha nta dị.
phase3.carpoolHelp: Lee ebe a na mbụ. Nhọrọ, ọkwa obodo naanị: lee onye na-aga nzụkọ gị jikọọ site na ozi app. Enweghị ekwentị, enweghị kpọmkwem ebe.
phase3.groupsHelp: Otu mgbake, nkwado nlaghachi, okwukwe na obodo site n'obodo na oge nzụkọ. Data atụ naanị — abụghị ezigbo ndepụta.
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: Na-egosi naanị mgbe ọ dịghị onye na bọọdụ na-aga nzụkọ gị. Na-ebipụta arịrịọ a haziri n'app — ọkwa obodo naanị, enweghị ekwentị.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: Enweghị ụgbọ ọnụ maka nzụkọ a, ya mere egosiri Achọrọ ụgbọ ka ndabere.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Naanị ndị ọkwọ ụgbọ a kwadoro. A na-eziga ozi otu n'otu na nchere nkeji 2; ị kwenyere tupu nke ọzọ.
phase3.approveContact: Kaa ka onye ọkwọ ụgbọ a kwadoro
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.musicHelp: Egwu atụ naanị. Enweghị akaụntụ nkwanye. Ngwa ahụ na-agbanyụ n'ime modulu akademi na ọmụmụ.
phase3.musicOffAcademy: Agbanyụrụ egwu mgbe ị nọ na modulu ọmụmụ.
